messages:
maya: kicking off a quick thread — we need to lock scope for the upcoming Optimize playbook sprint. customer asks are stacking: lower p99 for short-chat mobile, quant fallback for longcontext, and eval-triggered alerts for hallucination spikes. thoughts?
jordan: +1 — we should treat this as two deliverables: 1) recommendations engine (batching/caching/quant profiles) 2) alerts + guardrails. each needs clear acceptance criteria.
lee: for recommendations, we can surface per-route presets: small, medium, high-throughput. defaults: small=sync low-batch, medium=adaptive batching, high=continuous batching + KV caching. also include quant suggestions: int8 for non-LLM-sensitive routes, q4f for mixed.
samir: agree. can we make the quant recs tied to eval suites? e.g., run conv pouch through eval set; if topical quality drop < delta, allow q4f; else require FP16.
maya: exactly — landing criteria: 1) UI + API to surface recs, 2) evaluation harness to flag regressions automatically, 3) pilot with 2 customers and shipping runbook.
jordan: timeline check — sprint 2 (3 weeks) for MVP recs + basic eval checks. alerts (eval-triggered) should be parallel but we may ship them as alpha later.
lee: for the eval-triggered alerts: implement signal types: drop in rouge/bleu-like metric for structured tasks, increase in hallucination rate for chat (measured via reference checks + LLM critics). Ops needs thresholds and cooldowns.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: staging rollout window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. tagging: #optimize-playbook.
samir: criteria for pilot acceptance from customers: measurable p99 improvement OR >=15% token-cost reduction without >2% quality regression, plus clear escalation path.
maya: can product commit to a minimal UX: one-click apply recs per-route + explainers and rollback?
jordan: yes — we can do apply + preview and a rollback button that reverts to pinned model/config. backend will record experiments.
lee: technical note: continuous batching needs 50ms headroom on CPU/IO; if customers on small Dedicated pools we default to adaptive batching. mention in docs.
maya: last bit — decide canary plan: 10% traffic for 48h, monitor cost delta, p99, eval-signal. if any eval-alert fires, auto-roll back.
samir: +1. I'll draft the canary runbook and pilot ask. will share checklist in a follow-up.
maya: awesome — next steps: samir drafts runbook, lee PR for presets, jordan wires minimal UX, I'll book pilot outreach. ping if blocked. :rocket:
